ONE-TO-ONE WITH JOSH BARBEE

You talk.
Then you do the work.

One thing this week. Next time, we check if you did it.

HOW WE WORK

No unlimited
processing.

You tell the truth.

What happened? What did you do? What are you putting off? We start there.

You leave with one thing.

Something you will do this week. A clear action with a deadline.

You come back and account.

Did you do it? We look at what happened, correct what needs correcting, and set the next task.

BRING YOUR ACTUAL WEEK

Your mouth. Your body. Your word.

01 / YOUR MOUTH

Say it early.

The truth you keep delaying. The temper you bring home. The apology you still owe.

02 / YOUR BODY

Keep a rule.

Your sleep, your training, and the habits that decide what is left of you at the end of the day.

03 / YOUR WORD

Finish the job.

The promise you made. The decision you keep handing off. The work your house is waiting on.

WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

The man goes first.

This is not for men who want her to change first, men who want a vote instead of a head, or men who will not keep a small rule.

BEFORE WE TALK

Know what you’re signing up for.

Is this Christian coaching?

Yes. The Bible is the foundation. We work from the conviction that a man is accountable to God for how he leads his house.

Do I have to be married?

No. A man preparing to lead a house has work to do now. His word and his habits start before marriage.

Will you work on changing my wife?

I train the man first. We work on what you say, what you decide, and what you do. Her changing is not the condition for your obedience.

Is this therapy?

No. This is coaching built around action and accountability. It does not diagnose or treat mental health conditions.

When can I book?

Booking is not open yet. Session details and pricing will be posted here when it opens. For now, write down the one thing you will do this week.

Write your commitment

Pick the thing you will do this week. Then do it.
